pearls.purpose: Personal Solana wallet Pearl — sign transactions, hold tokens, anchor identity proofs. Wallet keys live encrypted inside the Pearl; all sensitive operations require an Identity Gate OTP rooted in the user's master keypair.

sidecars.label: Grain Crypto Journal
sidecars.purpose: Wallet key material + transaction history persisted encrypted; envelope keyed to the user's master.

sidecars.label: Grain Restore
sidecars.purpose: Portable wallet across machines without leaking the key.

sidecars.label: Identity Gate
sidecars.purpose: Every transaction signature is OTP-gated by the user's master keypair.

sidecars.label: Cap'n Proto WebSession
sidecars.purpose: Wallet-cap is raw capnp; consumed by peer Pearls (ccash, dueprocess) over Powerbox.

offers.name: wallet-sign
offers.purpose: Sign a presented payload with the user's wallet key — used by peer Pearls (ccash) when the user authorizes a transaction.

offers.name: wallet-pubkey
offers.purpose: Read-only: hand the wallet pubkey to a peer Pearl for verification.

adminOnly.name: Rotate wallet key
adminOnly.purpose: Master-OTP-gated key rotation; old key archived in audit log.

adminOnly.name: Manage Grapple consumers
adminOnly.purpose: Which peer Pearls may claim wallet-sign / wallet-pubkey.

anyMember.name: Sign transaction
anyMember.purpose: Standard wallet operation; OTP per high-value sig.

blockchains.purpose: Native SOL + SPL transfers + on-chain identity proofs against the license registry.

incomingApi.purpose: Wallet capability for peer Pearls — Powerbox-claim only.
